_comment: Sandboxed MCP plugins declared at DEPLOY time (origin=managed). This is the product's real path for a self-hoster: STANDMEET_PLUGINS points the backend at a manifest, and the plugin dirs are mounted read-only. It is the same kind of knob as INSTANCE_SECRET — deployment config, not an owner-facing install. (The marketplace installs skills, not sandbox_stdio plugins.) Used by the real-env audit to drive the sandbox item's checks 1 and 3 on the prod stack, where the isolation mechanism differs from dev's.
_why_three: Three declarations of the SAME two real servers, differing only in the sandbox dimension under test — so a difference in outcome can only come from the dimension, not from the server. netfetch/cagedfetch: identical fetch server, opposite egress policy. wsfs: the filesystem server with a per-session workspace bound at /workspace.

plugins._comment: wsfs —— server-filesystem rooted at /workspace with sandbox.workspace=true: exercises the per-session workspace lifecycle (#148). Reuses fsmcp's installed code; the host lazily binds a per-conversation /workspace dir, swept by the backend TTL cron.
